Company Description:
When caregivers struggle, everyone feels it. Thryve Labs helps them keep going with privacy-preserving, passive, personalized and predictive products that give caregivers peace of mind. Powered by AI.

Over 70 million Americans—due to age, disability, or chronic illness—depend on others for daily support. Most receive help not from professionals, but from 55 million unpaid caregivers: family members, friends, and neighbors who step in to fill the gap. Many of them don’t live nearby. Many are holding down jobs. Many are raising families of their own. They are stretched thin—physically, financially, and emotionally.

Thryve Labs believes that those who care for others need care and support too. Our solutions help lighten the load on unpaid and professional caregivers alike, because the people who care the most shouldn’t have to go it alone.

Thryve Labs offers the first predictive, privacy-preserving and personalized AI with contextual intelligence about individuals and their environments to guide best in class in-home and in-facility wellness and safety - in a cost effective, evidence-based manner

Using small interconnected sensors and devices that unobtrusively gather relevant signals, many not observable, communicable or known, Thryve's proprietary AI models work 24/7 to make inferences and predictions that track condition, care services, treatments, acute episodes and early risk indicators. 

On most days, Thryve won’t generate a prompt or alert - but with real-time dashboards and notifications (for facilities) as well as alerts and an always-on Interactive Virtual Advocate (for in-home), Thryve is ready to respond in real time to any atypical or acute event.

Company Description:
Feeding Matters is uniting the field’s leading medical experts, healthcare professionals, and passionate advocates with the most critical concerns of parents to affect systemic change.

ACCELERATING IDENTIFICATION
Delayed identification or intervention for children with pediatric feeding disorders can lead to poor brain development, deficient motor skills, and psychosocial impairment. Proper nutrition during the first few years of life is crucial for proper brain development. Because of this, the early identification of pediatric feeding disorders is critical to a child’s long-term health.

IGNITING RESEARCH
A lack of longitudinal, evidence-based data and the heterogeneous nature of pediatric feeding disorders have been identified as barriers to understanding more about the individualized needs of these children. Through strategic partnerships and seed funding, Feeding Matters supports research that addresses these issues head on.

PROMOTING COLLABORATIVE CARE
When caring for children with pediatric feeding disorders, parents often find themselves struggling with feelings of guilt, blame, isolation, helplessness, and even all-encompassing fear. By promoting a collaborative approach to care through four domains – medical, nutrition, feeding skill, and psychosocial –  Feeding Matters works to equip the entire care team, including the family, with the knowledge they need to effectively treat children who struggle to eat.

In 2017, Feeding Matters reached more than 129,000 families and medical professionals from all 50 states and 112 countries.

CorrectClips provide secure orientation of excised tissue on the image. CorrectClips allow a complete view of tissue so that lesions are quickly located. The surgeon applies the sterile clips while in the OR. The clips are translucent on the image; only the letters indicating orientation show brightly. This is superior to metal tags, which block the view of tissue behind the tag, and which cast a shadow that also occludes visibility.

The SilversteinWrap, a post-surgical, post-biopsy bias compression dressing, improves outcomes in breast surgery.  Complications such as hematomas, ecchymosis and seromas are common following breast surgery; they can delay healing and adjuvant therapy.  Validated with 25+ years of clinical use, the SilversteinWrap can improve patient satisfaction and help to prevent up to 24% of these complications.

Peelaways is a simple, practical solution designed for one of the hardest parts of caregiving: changing a bed after an accident.

Caregivers deal with incontinence every day. Traditional sheets, pads, and mattress protectors make bed changes slow, physical, and exhausting. They require lifting, stripping the bed, extra laundry, and repeated patient handling. Over time, this leads to caregiver strain, patient discomfort, and real safety risks.

Peelaways was created to make this moment easier.

Peelaways is a fitted bed sheet with multiple soft, disposable layers. Each layer is 100 percent waterproof. When a layer becomes soiled, it can be peeled away to reveal a clean sheet underneath. The bed can be reset in under 60 seconds, even while someone remains in bed.

For caregivers, this means less lifting, less laundry, and less physical strain.
For patients, it means less disruption, more comfort, and greater dignity.
For care teams, it means cleaner beds, protected mattresses, and more efficient use of time.

Peelaways is used in homecare, hospice, assisted living, pediatric care, and other clinical and non-clinical settings. It helps caregivers manage incontinence safely and efficiently while supporting aging in place and quality of care.

This is not a replacement for care. It is a tool that supports caregivers in doing their job better, with less burnout and fewer risks.

Peelaways was built around real caregiving needs, not theory. Our goal is simple: make everyday care easier, safer, and more humane for everyone involved.

Company Description:
The Healthy Teen Project provides Intensive Outpatient and Partial Hospitalization treatment programs for teenagers who struggle with eating disorders in the San Francisco Bay Area.

Eating disorders create significant challenges for teens and their families in all aspects of their lives. Sometimes these challenges require intensive treatment. Through our multidisciplinary approach, we address physical, emotional, and nutritional health, academic functioning, and family and peer relationships. Our goal is to provide holistic care that supports adolescents and their families in finding new and healthy ways of living.

Our program provides structure and support. It gives clients a chance to connect, relate and problem solve with others that struggle with similar issues. We help guide families in supporting their loved ones in a safe and caring way.

Our Partial Hospitalization Program (PHP) provides clients the opportunity to receive intensive day treatment while remaining in familiar surroundings at home and with family. PHP is a period of treatment between acute hospitalization and/or residential treatment and lower levels of care, such as an Intensive Outpatient Program (IOP) or outpatient care.  

Our Intensive Outpatient Program (IOP) is designed to meet the needs of teens who require more physical, emotional and nutritional support than they can get from seeing their outpatient providers once or twice a week. The program also provides step-down care from Partial Hospitalization Programs or Residential Treatment.  

Our multidisciplinary team consists of professionals with medical, psychiatric, therapy and nutritional backgrounds that treat teens with eating disorders. Together our team has over 75 years of treating eating disorder patients across a range of environments including: in-patient medical and psychiatric hospitalization, residential treatment centers, partial hospitalization and intensive outpatient programs, as well as outpatient clinics.

Unlike traditional liquid biopsy alteration testing that focus solely on static DNA mutations, GenomicsNext™ unlocks dynamic, functional insights into the tumor’s “on state,” enhancing biomarker discovery, therapy selection, and clinical trial enrichment. 

GeneCentric partners with biopharma, diagnostic developers, and researchers to enable expression-driven companion diagnostics, particularly for emerging therapies like antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs), and to develop novel blood-based biomarkers that address current gaps in cancer care.

Through its cutting-edge technology and deep expertise, GeneCentric is expanding the boundaries of what ctDNA can reveal and advancing the next generation of precision medicine.

Company Description:
The standard of care for healing broken bones hasn't changed in over fifty years. Invasive metal hardware is still routinely used to fixate bones–often with less-than-optimal patient outcomes. RevBio® is a medical device company that has invented TETRANITE®, a regenerative bone adhesive currently in 150 patients across seven FDA approved clinical trials. Our patented “bone glue” is founded upon a comprehensive patent portfolio with global patent protection extending through 2042. Easily injectable into a range of musculoskeletal defects, TETRANITE has demonstrated superior performance over other standard of care options in curing speed and strength, rate of resorption, bone regeneration, and most critically wet-field adhesion. As a novel technology, TETRANITE is anticipated to receive a De Novo classification for several indications which will expedite the path to commercialization by Q3 2027. Bioengineered for a body of applications, the TETRANITE platform will address a total addressable market of over $10 billion in neurosurgical, orthopaedic and dental use cases.Inspired by the marine animal the sandcastle worm, Tetranite is simple chemistry. Bioengineered from the worm’s secreted protein, our synthetic adhesive is the only patented biomaterial which satisfies both the required and desired properties for a bone adhesive: wet field performance, multi-surface bonding, rapid mechanical stability, and controlled biodegradability.

The properties of Tetranite™ include the ability to provide immediate fixation of bone to bone and bone to metal. This adhesive has been shown in multiple animal studies to be a non-toxic and effective way of repairing bone fractures and defects as well as securing implant devices.  Existing data has also shown that Tetranite™ is reabsorbed and replaced with new bone during the natural process of bone remodeling by acting as a scaffold to facilitate bone growth over time.

Title: CEO & Co-Founder
Company Description:
Adverse event grading in oncology is still manual, inconsistent, and time-consuming, in clinical trials and in postmarket surveillance. Burna AI is building the platform that makes safety data accurate, consistent, and submission-ready across the entire drug lifecycle.

Our first product, CTCAE AI, automates adverse event grading with:

- CTCAE grading (v5.0 and v6.0) with citation to source text and criteria
- Multi-drug causality attribution using WHO-UMC and Kramer algorithms with probability scoring per drug
- 42 pre-built oncology regimen profiles for combination therapy
- Batch clinical note processing: one note in, all AEs graded
- Comorbidity-aware grading: distinguishes drug toxicities from pre-existing conditions
- Patient self-reporting module enabling continuous CTCAE grading between visits
- Automated safety reporting: IND safety reports, CIOMS forms, MedWatch, DSURs
- Postmarket pharmacovigilance: MedDRA coding, E2B(R3) formatting for electronic regulatory submission
- Zero hallucination architecture: outputs constrained to valid CTCAE grades with mandatory citations
- Human-in-the-loop always: AI suggests, clinicians decide

Built for regulated environments from day one. HIPAA compliant. SOC 2 certified. 21 CFR Part 11 aligned. Real-time architecture built from the ground up. EHR/EDC integration via SMART on FHIR for Epic, Oracle Health, Medidata, and Veeva Vault EDC.

Partnering with leading academic cancer centers on clinical validation. Our advisory network spans oncologists at NCI-designated cancer centers, pharma clinical development leaders, clinical informaticists, and federal health IT executives.

TheraTogs are available in North America, South America, Europe, the UK, and Australia.

There has not been a way to measure oral health. Dental care today revolves around diagnosing and treating oral disease but does little in the way of prevention and whole-body health. 

Bristle analyzes the oral microbiome - the makeup of bacteria, fungi, and viruses in saliva - to measure oral health status. Some of these microbes are helpful, and contribute to good oral health while lowering our risk for disease. Other microbes are harmful, directly or indirectly leading to oral and systemic disease. 

Our test provides you with direct insight into your oral health and risk factors for disease. Based on other factors including your medical history, diet, and hygiene, we pair you with personalized recommendations focused on repairing and maintaining balance in your oral microbiome. 

We believe that improving oral health is a fundamental step towards improving overall health - and we'd like to help you get here.

One in eight older American’s (approximately 5.4 million individuals) has Alzheimer’s disease. Caregiver Cards is a series of illustrations used by caregivers for communication, prompts and cues with individuals who may have Alzheimer’s disease, dementia or related memory and/or speech disorders.

At National Addiction Specialists, we understand that overcoming addiction can be challenging. That's why we offer outpatient telemedicine opioid use disorder treatment: an easy way to receive the same level of care as if you were in a clinic, but with greater anonymity and less time spent traveling or waiting in lines.

Let's face it: overcoming addiction can be challenging. But at National Addiction Specialists, we want to remove all barriers by providing ease of care through the use of innovative technology. Our treatment process includes 3 primary phases:

STEP 1: Induction
Your first telemedicine call with your provider will be learning about your history of opioid abuse to help transition you to a clean life to curb your cravings and stop your withdrawals. After your induction visit, your provider will give you a stabilization program. As with your first visit, the scheduled “return” visits will also be via telemedicine.  Your provider will e-prescribe the medication/prescription and instruct you on the dosage that you should take and perform this screening process to assess how you are feeling. And will make any changes until the dose is appropriate for you.

STEP 3: Maintenance

Opioid addiction is a chronic disease that requires ongoing monitoring, care, and support. Maintenance can be highly effective if the patient is diligent with appointments and individual/group counseling. The primary benefits of maintenance include significantly decreasing the risk of relapse.

Company Description:
THERAPHA is a patient-friendly technology that replaces traditional paper-based intake forms with a conversational style chatbot. The solution aids healthcare providers in making informed decisions by suggesting one or more clinical hypothesis based on the patient's self-reported symptoms and medical history. However, it is important to note that THERAPHA's suggestions should only be used as an aid and not a replacement for a healthcare provider's clinical reasoning and judgment. The technology utilizes scientific advancements to improve clinical reasoning and better utilize clinician time for face-to-face interactions with patients.

THERAPHA is a patented patient-facing clinical decision support system for comprehensive musculoskeletal triage and decision support over a tech-enabled platform. The tool utilizes a series of empathetically drafted, clinically relevant questions to emulate a thorough one-on-one interaction between a patient and a musculoskeletal expert. The digital assistant or avatar in the chatbot simulates the incident that led the patient to seek care, enabling them to provide a detailed account of their complaints and concerns. Since the "digital twin" represents the patient themselves, Therapha’s knowledge repository identifies the best possible match and presents the inference to the care navigator or to the treating clinician even before their in-person or virtual visit. Using the power of technology, Therapha detects hidden patterns and performs a technology enabled clinical reasoning, and automates the subjective portion of clinical documentation in a narrative format. The tool has efficiently incorporated guideline or criterion-specific recommendations, delivering them within the clinical workflow. The inferences are similar to a nutrition label, explaining how the tool derived its conclusions, satisfying concerns about the tool's explainability.

Company Description:
TheraVista is changing the game in vestibular physical therapy. 

Physical Therapists prescribe our app to engage patients in evidence-based games for vestibular & balance rehabilitation.  Physical Therapists can bill Medicare and commercial plans for this Remote Therapy Monitoring (RTM), improving clinic revenue and patient outcomes at the same time.  

TheraVista was born out of NIH-funded research into motion tracking and evidence-based games to help patients with vestibular issues like vertigo, dizziness, PPPD, and vestibular hypofunction. After successful clinical trials with the University of Kansas Medical Center, TheraVista was created to commercialize this new approach. 

Today, most physical therapists send patients home with a paper handout of vestibular exercises, perhaps with a few links to videos demonstrating the techniques. 

TheraVista's approach is to have our App on the patient's own smartphone to do many of the things at home that a therapist would do in the office. The app is designed to prompt patients with the right exercises on the right schedule, watch them do the exercise, provide corrective feedback, and ask questions afterward to assess how it went.  

Thanks to new CPT codes for Remote Therapy Monitoring (RTM) in 2022, our solution lets physical therapists earn additional revenue while improving patient outcomes.

This response gives our bodies the ability to heal damaged cells and remove hazardous waste. Examples of inflammation include pain, redness, swelling, and loss of function. Although these indications allow us to recognize recovery has started, inflammation can become chronic and detrimental to the body if therapeutic care is not initiated right away. The recovery process after an injury or surgery is crucial for long term mobility and prevention of chronic inflammation and chronic pain.

A combination of cryotherapy and compression can reduce inflammation, pain, stiffness, swelling, and improve range of motion, allowing for a more efficient recovery. It is important to note that improved pain control produces a greater likelihood of independence from narcotic (opioid) use.

NEMS cryotherapy continuum of care means that the Therm-X can be used through the entire recovery process - starting in the post anesthesia care unit, transitioning to the patient’s home, and continuing through physical therapy. Title: Founder and CEO
Company Description:
At Icarus Medical Innovations, our mission is simple yet powerful: to improve lives by reducing pain and enhancing movement. We put the patient first, designing innovative orthopedic solutions that push the boundaries of 3D-printing, biomechanics, and design to create braces that provide real, lasting relief.

Our approach is driven by cutting-edge technology and a commitment to innovation, but at our core, we are a company built by real people with real experiences—starting with our founder, Dave Johnson.

Dave’s journey began at 15 years old, when a football injury led to a knee dislocation and early-onset arthritis decades ahead of the typical timeline. By his early 30s, facing bone-on-bone osteoarthritis, he was told his only real option was a knee replacement—a solution that came with risks, limitations, and long-term complications.

Determined to find another way, Dave had an idea: what if a brace could unload the knee the same way weight loss could reduce joint stress? With that, he built his first prototype in his garage—a knee brace with built-in springs to provide real-time relief. And it worked.

Seeing firsthand how this concept transformed his own mobility, Dave began refining the design, helping others with similar conditions, and ultimately launching Icarus Medical to bring true innovation to orthopedic bracing.

Today, Icarus Medical leads the industry with 3D-printed, patient-centric solutions that provide custom fit, superior comfort, and dynamic support. Our braces aren’t just medical devices—they are tools to help people reclaim their active lifestyles and live without limits.

With a foundation built on technology, patient experience, and relentless innovation, we are reshaping the future of orthopedic support—one brace at a time.

If you’re a clinician looking to enhance your bracing program or a patient wondering if Icarus products are right for you, we’d love to connect. Feel free to send us a message or email at info@icarusmedical.com.

At the end of 2017, one of the founding members, Dr. Romett, retired, and Dr. Baswell retired in mid-2018.  Dr. Keller joined the practice in the fall of 2018, and Dr. Yohanan retired at the end of the same year.  Dr. Pruitt, one of the founding members, retired in mid-2018. 

In the fall of 2020, two physicians joined the practice:  Dr. Webber, an allergist, and Dr. Beckmann, an ENT.  In the spring of 2021, CENT&A closed its NorthCare location and opened up its St. Peregrine office.  Combined with Audubon, the two main locations have over 24,000 square feet of clinical space to serve the Southern Colorado community. Company Description:
QuitSure is a structured, 6-day smoking cessation program that is delivered entirely through a mobile app. 80.1% of program completers successfully quit smoking, based on peer-reviewed research published in JMIR (2024). Unlike traditional quit-smoking tools that rely on nicotine replacement or willpower, QuitSure is built on three evidence-based psychological methodologies: Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), Rational Emotive Behavior Therapy (REBT), and guided self-hypnosis. Users continue smoking during the program and quit naturally by day 6. This app is present in over 175+ countries, with over 3M+ downloads. 

QuitSure program follows a counter-intuitive design: users are expected to continue smoking throughout the 6-day duration. During this period, the app delivers daily sessions that include video content, cognitive restructuring exercises, mindful smoking activities, and guided self-hypnosis audio. These sessions systematically dismantle the false beliefs, emotional attachments, and subconscious triggers that sustain the smoking habit. By the time users reach day 6, the desire to smoke has been addressed at its root, and quitting feels like a natural conclusion rather than a forced sacrifice.

The effectiveness of QuitSure’s approach has been validated through peer-reviewed research. A cross-sectional study published in JMIR Human Factors (2024), involving 1,286 program completers, found that 80.1% maintained prolonged abstinence for 30 or more days after completing the program. Additionally, 85% of successful quitters reported experiencing no nicotine withdrawal symptoms after 30 days. These findings position QuitSure as one of the most evidence-backed psychological smoking cessation apps available globally.

Nearly all addicted individuals believe at the outset that they can stop using drugs on their own, and most try to stop without treatment. Although some people are successful, many attempts result in failure to achieve long-term abstinence. Research has shown that long-term drug abuse results in changes in the brain that persist long after a person stops using drugs. These drug-induced changes in brain function can have many behavioral consequences, including an inability to exert control over the impulse to use drugs despite adverse consequences—the defining characteristic of addiction.
Understanding that addiction has such a fundamental biological component may help explain the difficulty of achieving and maintaining abstinence without treatment. Psychological stress from work, family problems, psychiatric illness, pain associated with medical problems, social cues (such as meeting individuals from one’s drug-using past), or environmental cues (such as encountering streets, objects, or even smells associated with drug abuse) can trigger intense cravings without the individual even being consciously aware of the triggering event. Any one of these factors can hinder attainment of sustained abstinence and make relapse more likely. Nevertheless, research indicates that active participation in treatment is an essential component for good outcomes and can benefit even the most severely addicted individuals.

The agency exists to provide support and care for persons in the last phases of a life-limiting illness, so that they may live as fully and comfortably as possible. This is accomplished through an individualized program of physical, emotional, spiritual and practical care for people and their families in the last phases of a life-limiting illness emphasizing the control of pain and other symptoms and by utilizing an interdisciplinary group approach of physicians, nurses, social workers, therapists, homemakers, hospice aides, volunteers, spiritual counselors, bereavement counselors and others.

The program is reflective of a spirit and idea of caring that emphasizes comfort and dignity for the dying, making it possible for the patient to remains as independent as possible and to remain in their familiar surroundings.

The agency exists in the belief that, through appropriate care and the promotion of a caring community, patients and family/caregivers will be free to attain a degree of mental preparation for death that is satisfying to them.

Today, the community spirit of the founders still drives Heartlinks — “Neighbor Serving Neighbor.” Care comes from the heart. Patients and families come first. It is our great privilege to provide end-of-life services to all individuals living in both Benton County and Yakima Counties.
